name: ai-application-greenfield
description: Guided greenfield setup for AI applications with explicit AI quality, safety, failure-mode, and operational evaluation.

questions.prompt: What kind of project are you starting?

options.label: AI or LLM application
options.reason: Recommended because this setup materializes an AI-specific evaluation agent, skill, artifact contract, and workflow gate.

options.label: Data pipeline
options.reason: Blocked because this setup requires AI application evaluation rather than data ingestion, transformation, and data-quality gates. Use a dedicated data-pipeline setup when registered.

options.label: Web API
options.reason: Blocked because this setup includes an AI evaluation gate that a general web API does not require. Use a dedicated web-api setup when registered.

options.label: Library or package
options.reason: Blocked because this setup includes AI application evaluation and final QA responsibilities beyond a focused library delivery flow. Use a dedicated library setup when registered.

options.label: Documentation-only project
options.reason: Blocked because this setup requires implementation, AI evaluation, testing, code review, and QA artifacts.

questions.prompt: How should AI behavior be evaluated?

options.label: Evidence-based AI evaluation
options.reason: Recommended because the workflow requires measurable criteria, evaluation scenarios, failure analysis, limitations, and reproducible evidence before ordinary software validation.

options.label: Demo-based approval
options.reason: Blocked because a demonstration does not provide reproducible evidence for quality, safety, failure behavior, or operating limits.

options.label: Ad-hoc AI review
options.reason: Blocked because this setup uses a deterministic AI evaluation gate with a required artifact contract.

options.label: No separate AI evaluation
options.reason: Blocked because omitting the AI evaluation gate would require a different workflow and bundle.

questions.prompt: Which target agent platforms should be generated?

options.label: OpenCode and VS Code Copilot
options.reason: Recommended because both registered target adapters support the complete AI application composition.

options.label: OpenCode only
options.reason: Compatible because the OpenCode target adapter is registered.

options.label: VS Code Copilot only
options.reason: Compatible because the VS Code Copilot target adapter is registered.
